newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian c. bank sells 695 bln rbls bills, bonds.
newsitem.headline: Russian c. bank sells 695 bln rbls bills, bonds.

text.p: The Russian central bank sold 695.30 billion roubles nominal of GKO discount Treasury bills and OFZ interest-bearing government bonds on behalf of the Finance Ministry on Tuesday, the bank's open-market operations department said.
The bank made the following transactions:

The bank did not say at what price the paper was sold. The 21076 issue closed on Tuesday at 84.92 percent, the 21078 issue closed at 84.40 percent, the 22081 issue closed at 88.80 percent, the 22085 issue closed at 88.02 percent, the 23007 issue closed at 86.06 percent, the 24014 issue closed at 99.05 percent and the 25001 issue closed at 102.98 percent.

Apart from intervening on its own account for liquidity-smoothing and monetary policy purposes, the central bank buys and sells securities as part of its management of the Finance Ministry's debt and asset portfolio.
